text:
Maya (AM): kicking off StratusOne reseller pilot. Need a compact technical handoff for SSO/SCIM, entitlement mapping, partner egress IPs, client cert exchange, reseller pricing model, and tenant provisioning runbook. CC @Alex (Solutions) @Samir (SRE)

Alex (Solutions): I can owner SSO/SCIM. Do we have an existing entitlement-to-group mapping template we can reuse?

Samir (SRE): partner will call our private endpoints from their VPC. Need egress IPs, TLS details, and client cert flow. Also advise keepalive/idle timeouts.

Jia (Security): I'll pull the completed security questionnaire and SOC2 link. Need to confirm KMS options and data residency constraints. Also note: no PII in logs, and we require customer-managed KMS for enterprise resellers.

Todd (Partnerships): pricing: partner expects reseller-aware SKU and a short-term margin (10% off usage for first 6 months). Sales needs a temporary "reseller-dedicated" SKU we can invoice against. I'll draft numbers. :memo:

Maya (AM): proposed runbook steps: 1) entitlement mapping (SCIM groups -> tiers) 2) SAML + SCIM setup + test cases 3) network allowlist + cert exchange 4) billing & reseller SKU onboarding 5) smoke tests + rollback. Who picks what?

Alex (Solutions): I'll draft the SAML + SCIM instructions (metadata, ACS, entityID, example group mapping, sample SCIM payloads) and include minimal test steps. Will link to PR.

Samir (SRE): partner allowlist snippet for their infra: 

```
# partner firewall (egress)
# allow outbound to staging and prod endpoints
-A OUTPUT -d 34.82.101.12/32 -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -d 34.82.101.13/32 -j ACCEPT
# prod endpoint
prod.redwood-inference.net:443
# staging endpoint
staging.redwood-inference.net:443
```

Note: client certificate exchange is manual: partner uploads CSR to portal, we return signed cert. Add rotation guidance and expiration checks. Idle timeout recommendation: 60s.

Jia (Security): security checklist items to add to runbook: mTLS for control-plane calls, optional customer-managed KMS ARN for encryption-at-rest, redaction policy for logs (no PII), SOC2 report link and compliance contact. I'll attach redacted questionnaire responses.

Maya (AM): partner wants SSO validated before wiring billing. Can we enable SAML + SCIM provisioning for initial validation?

Alex (Solutions): yes. SCIM scopes: scim:write:users, scim:read:groups. Provide a sample curl for provisioning and a staging token.

Samir (SRE): staging provision endpoint + example payload: 

```
POST https://staging.redwood-inference.net/v1/accounts/provision
Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN_abc
{
  "partner_org": "stratusone",
  "admin_email": "alice@stratus.one"
}
```

Response returns account_id. Use staging token with limited quota for tests.

Todd (Partnerships): pricing proposal (draft): 10% reseller discount on hosted API usage for 6 months + $2,000/month reserved commitment for baseline RU. I'll attach the formal pricing sheet to the runbook.

Maya (AM): owners and deadlines: Alex -> SAML/SCIM doc by EOD; Samir -> allowlist IPs + cert exchange steps by tomorrow AM; Jia -> security questionnaire + SOC2 link; Todd -> pricing draft. Partner meeting Wed 10am PT. @deploy-bot set reminder 1h before. :calendar:

deploy-bot: reminder set for 2024-04-10T09:00:00Z (1 hour before meeting)

Samir (SRE): confirmed partner allowlist IPs: 34.82.101.12, 34.82.101.13, 34.82.101.14. Staging: staging.redwood-inference.net:443. Added keepalive and idletimeout notes.

Jia (Security): SOC2 link (internal): https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2.pdf  will attach redacted answers to runbook.

Alex (Solutions): pushed SAML/SCIM draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/presales/runbooks/pull/58  includes metadata XML example, SCIM sample payload, and group-to-tier mapping table.

Samir (SRE): ops smoke test snippet for post-provision: 

```
# smoke test
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN" https://staging.redwood-inference.net/v1/models/list
# expect 200 + models array
```

Alex (Solutions): I'll add that test case to the SAML doc.

Maya (AM): thanks all. I'll consolidate into the handoff doc and share with StratusOne before Wed. Please drop any call notes or updates into the PR. :raised_hands:
